news.headline: Realty firms' land acquisition falls 56% to 1,445 acres in Jan-Sep: Anarock
news.summary: In the first nine months of 2026, a notable drop in land acquisition activities by Indian real estate firms has been observed. Anarock attributes this decline to developers adopting a cautious strategy, influenced by rising costs and emphasized selectivity in land purchases. Notably, joint development agreements with landowners represented 25% of all deals, hinting at a stronger focus on project feasibility and connectivity.

news.headline: India bonds slip as Treasury rout offsets oil slide
news.summary: Indian government bonds declined on Wednesday as a sharp rise in US Treasury yields, triggered by hotter-than-expected inflation and hawkish signals from policymakers, overshadowed relief from lower crude oil prices. Higher US yields could erode the relative return advantage of Indian debt, dampening its appeal among foreign investors.

news.headline: Punjab National Bank among 7 stocks showing White Marubozu pattern
news.summary: Seven Nifty500 stocks featured in StockEdge’s White Marubozu bullish scanner on November 9, indicating strong upward price momentum during the session. Banking stocks dominated the list, with gains ranging from 4% to 5.6%.

news.headline: Union Bank of India among 5 stocks closing above VWAP
news.summary: Five Nifty500 stocks closed more than 2% above their respective volume-weighted average prices on November 9, according to StockEdge’s technical scan, indicating positive price action during the session.

news.headline: CoreWeave stock jumps after earnings: 7 things driving the AI cloud company's rally
news.summary: ​CoreWeave shares surge after beating Q3 earnings expectations, reporting 168% revenue growth and a $132.5 billion backlog, while raising 2026 guidance despite mounting debt and infrastructure spending concerns.

news.headline: Bharat Dynamics among 5 stocks showing RSI trending up
news.summary: Five Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% on November 9 featured in StockEdge’s RSI Trending Up scan, with their Relative Strength Index (RSI) crossing above 50 from below, signalling strengthening price momentum.

news.headline: US Treasury rout hands India's 10-year bond its worst day in a month
news.summary: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee gained strength against the dollar, reaching its highest point since April. This improvement was influenced by foreign investments in local stocks and upbeat sentiment in the non-deliverable forward market. Although inflation concerns in the US led to a stronger dollar, traders remained focused on foreign portfolio investments in Indian equities.

news.headline: These 12 midcap stocks rally up to 30% in just one month
news.summary: While the Nifty 50 has rallied nearly 11% in a month, several midcap stocks have outperformed the broader index. Here are 12 midcap stocks that have surged between 15% and 30% during this period, according to ACE Equity data.

news.headline: Rupee touches strongest since April as foreign inflows offset firm dollar
news.summary: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee surged to its healthiest value since April, closing at 93.69 against the dollar. This upswing was driven by a remarkable influx of foreign investments in local stocks, totaling nearly $6 billion in November. Even in light of a stronger dollar amid US inflation signals, the rupee stood firm. There's a notable optimistic shift in market sentiment, now eager for India's inflation data anticipated for October.

news.headline: Bajaj Finance to launch share sale worth up to Rs 11,700 cr this week: Report
news.summary: Bajaj Finance Ltd. is gearing up for a major share sale aimed at raising an impressive 117 billion rupees. The initiative seeks to draw in institutional investors, with the specifics of the offering currently being finalized. Following the completion of investor roadshows, a qualified institutions placement may take place soon.

news.headline: Nvidia Stock Sell-Off Deepens: Spy scandal, price target cuts put AI giant under pressure
news.summary: Nvidia shares plunge nearly 10% amid technology sell-offs, leadership controversy and AI valuation concerns. Analyst price-target cuts deepen investor anxiety ahead of November 17 quarterly earnings.

news.headline: Rupee rises 7 paise to 93.70 against US dollar in early trade
news.summary: The rupee strengthened 7 paise to 93.70 against the US dollar in early trade on Wednesday, supported by sustained foreign fund inflows, easing crude oil prices and improving geopolitical sentiment. The domestic currency has emerged as one of Asia's best performers in FY27, with traders expecting continued overseas investor participation to provide a buffer against external uncertainties.

news.headline: Positive Breakout: These 5 stocks rose above their 200 DMAs
news.summary: Six Nifty 500 stocks gained over 2% and crossed above their respective 200-day moving averages on November 9, according to StockEdge data. A move above the 200-DMA is widely seen as a bullish technical signal, suggesting a potential shift towards an uptrend.

news.headline: India’s rich pivot to real estate after stock returns falter
news.summary: Investors in India are increasing their allocations towards high-yielding assets in real estate and logistics. Recent data shows a significant rise in investments through Alternative Investment Funds, nearly doubling in recent years. Family offices are now directing larger portions of their portfolios toward private credit and infrastructure while moving away from traditional investments. Specialized funds are attracting wealthy investors who want exposure to completed assets.
